title: The Terminal of Station Meridian Again
author: Lior Joubert
blurb: Elodie Vane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
